source.quote: Net interest margin (“NIM”) was 3.10% for the current quarter, an increase of 1 basis point from the linked quarter.
Common equity Tier 1 risk-based capital, and Tier 1 leverage ratios were 13.37%, 11.73%, 10.77%, and 9.22%, respectively

source.section: PROVISION FOR CREDIT LOSSES AND CREDIT QUALITY
source.quote: Net charge-offs were $108 million (0.29% of average loans) for the current quarter
Deposits were $173.43 billion at June 30, 2026, an increase of $2.59 billion or 1.5%

source.section: PROVISION FOR CREDIT LOSSES AND CREDIT QUALITY
source.quote: Benefit for credit losses was $10 million for the current quarter, compared to a provision for credit losses of $72 million
